title: helianthemum polifolium var. calcareum
intro: Helianthemum polifolium var. calcareum, commonly known as Rockrose, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Cistaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in soothing skin irritations and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Rockrose include astringency, which helps to reduce bleeding and swelling, and antiseptic properties, which inhibit the growth of microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of Rockrose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
